observations: Photo 0 shows a sealed cardboard box for a table gas stove.
Box front reads "TABLE GAS STOVE" vertically in two places.
Brand logo "Boscon" appears on the left and right sides of the box.
Product image on the box shows a black tabletop gas cooker with burners.
Watermark "OSILLE-MACO ELECTRONICS" is stamped across the center.
Box appears taped and unopened; the actual unit is not visible.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows Boscon logo on the box
photo 0 box text reads TABLE GAS STOVE
box does not show whether the unit has legs or a stand
box image shows metallic burners but material cannot be confirmed from the photo
photo 0 product image shows a black cooker
flame strength cannot be judged from a sealed box photo

risks.risk: Unit may be damaged, missing parts, or non-functional despite the sealed box
risks.proof: Video of the unit unboxed, connected to gas, and igniting all burners

risks.risk: Stainless steel claim may be false; body or grates may be enamel or mild steel
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the actual cooker body, grates, and knobs out of the box

risks.risk: Gas type or ignition system may not suit local supply
risks.proof: Photo of the specification or rating plate showing gas type and model

proof_requests: Video of the stove unboxed and ignited on all burners
Close-up photos of the actual cooker body, grates, and knobs out of the box
Photo of the specification plate showing gas type and model
response.reason: The box clearly identifies a Boscon BDS-55012 table gas stove in black, so it can be priced at its worst case as a sealed, untested unit that may not work.
